content:
Jamie (AM): quick weekly health check for Cobaltix — focus: p95/p99 split by route + model, streaming vs non-streaming. attaching top-line numbers below.
Molly (CS): TL;DR: overall usage steady, cost up 8% (embedding spikes), latency p95 ok but p99 bumped on chat.stream routes after last week's model swap.
Ben (Infra): saw the same in dashboards. notable: chat.stream -> vicuna-13b-quant shows p99 ~2.1s vs 0.9s for sync.chat on same model.
Raj (SRE): AlertBot fired at 2321123300 for chat.stream p99 > 2s (sustained 15m). stack traces look like kv-cache miss amplification during prefix-heavy requests.
Molly (CS): customer notes increased aborts for long conversations; they think streaming UI is timing out. reported by CS contact: "stream hangs then client retries".
Jamie (AM): can we get per-route breakdown? especially: /chat.stream vs /chat.sync and the reranking route /rank which they use heavily.
Ben (Infra): quick snapshot (p95 / p99) last 24h for Cobaltix:
- /chat.sync (vicuna-13b-quant): p95 0.85s, p99 1.05s
- /chat.stream (vicuna-13b-quant): p95 0.95s, p99 2.10s
- /rank (bert-small): p95 0.12s, p99 0.25s
- embeddings (text-sim-2): p95 0.45s, p99 0.78s
Molly (CS): errors: overall error rate 0.8% (up from 0.3%). most errors are transient stream disconnects and 503s from the chunking worker.
Raj (SRE): hypothesis: the quantized model has larger per-token memory pressure causing intermittent page faults under streaming mode (KV growth). streaming keeps open connections -> heavier memory footprint -> swap-like behavior.
Ben (Infra): repro note: if you run a high-concurrency streaming workload with long prefixes (>1024 tokens) we observe KV eviction churn. Short-term mitigations: reduce conn concurrency, enable kv-cache-prune heuristics, or route heavy prefix sessions to sync endpoints.
Jamie (AM): customer asks for temporary mitigation while we investigate. Molly, can we propose routing fix + client timeout tweak?
Molly (CS): yes. propose: 1) route heavy sessions to /chat.sync via routing rule (canary for 10% first) 2) ask client to bump streaming keepalive to 45s (they currently 15s) 3) enable KV prune on their Dedicated pool (Ben to confirm safety)
Ben (Infra): confirm: KV prune toggle is safe; will impact latency for very long continuation sessions but reduces p99 spikes. I can enable on their dedicated nodes tonight, roll back if regress.
Raj (SRE): also recommending a short canary rollback of vicuna-13b-quant on streaming route if spikes continue after KV prune. fallback to vicuna-13b-fp16 variant is compatible.
AlertBot: [ALERT] 2321123300 - chat.stream p99 exceeded 2.0s for customer=cobaltix (duration 15m) :rotating_light:
Jamie (AM): action items:
- Ben: enable KV prune toggle on Cobaltix dedicated pool tonight (owner)
- Ben: add routing rule to route 10% of heavy-prefix sessions to /chat.sync canary
- Molly: send customer note with recommended client timeout bump & monitor ask
- Raj: prepare quick rollback playbook for vicuna-13b-quant -> vicuna-13b-fp16
Timeline: implement mitigations today, reassess tomorrow morning.
Molly (CS): I'll draft the customer note now and ping once done.
Ben (Infra): starting KV prune enable in 10m, will post logs here when done.
Raj (SRE): I'll draft rollback steps and test on staging, post ETA by EOD.
Jamie (AM): thanks team. callout: also flag renewal risk if we can't stabilize p99 in 48h; Molly include that in the outreach (tone: proactive, technical).
